name: Milestone Register
query:
SELECT
    m.name AS "ID:Link/PhD Milestone:180px",
    s.scholar_name AS "Scholar",
    s.roll_number AS "Roll Number",
    s.department AS "Department",
    m.milestone_type AS "Milestone Type",
    m.status AS "Status",
    m.approval_body AS "Approval Body",
    m.resolution_number AS "Resolution No.",
    m.resolution_date AS "Resolution Date",
    m.notes AS "Notes"
FROM `tabPhD Milestone` m
JOIN `tabPhD Scholar` s ON s.name = m.scholar
WHERE s.name LIKE %(scholar)s
  AND ifnull(s.department, '') LIKE %(department)s
ORDER BY s.department, s.roll_number, m.resolution_date
